column1: # Dart definition rule. Recorded: class (also abstract, sealed, base, final, interface, mixin class
# and "class A = B with C"), enum, extension and extension type (class; an unnamed extension has no
# name and is not recorded), mixin (interface), typedef (type_alias), enum constants (constant).
# Functions: function at file level or nested in a function, method in a type. Constructors,
# getters, setters and operators in a type are methods; a constructor is named as written (Shape, Shape.named, Shape._); an operator by its symbol.
# Variables: const/final initialised at file level and static const/final in a type are constant,
# other file-level variables are variable, other members are field.
# Not recorded: locals, parameters, calls, imports, the library directive, an unnamed extension.
# A symbol's range is its signature (the grammar keeps the body as a sibling node).
